summary: Tested the new Group Food Vote feature end to end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass. The poll API handles create (at least 2 options, capped at 6), list, get, vote (changing a vote replaces it, invalid choice gives 400, voter_id under 4 chars gives 422), close (winner set, null on a tie, voting after close gives 400), delete, 404 for bad ids, and the HTML /page. The browser voting page works: you can enter a name, vote, change the vote and the checkmark moves, and the vote and name persist after a reload. In the app, pizza chip -> results -> start-group-vote-button creates a poll and goes to /poll/[id]. Tapping poll-option-0 raises the count from 0 to 1 and shows the checkmark. Changing the vote works. poll-close-button shows poll-winner and hides share and close. The trip detail start-group-vote-button creates a poll titled 'Lunch in Rome — where to?'. The Saved tab 'Group votes' list (poll-item-*) opens the poll screen. Deleting a poll from the poll screen goes back. One functional gap: on web, the share button does nothing in browsers without navigator.share. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {ok:true} for ids that are invalid or don't exist instead of 404. This doesn't match GET, vote and close, which return 404.
A poll with 0 votes can be closed through the API, and closing an already-closed poll is accepted again. The UI disables the button when there are 0 votes, but the API has no guard.

ui_bugs.issue: Share.share on react-native-web needs navigator.share. Desktop Chrome, Firefox and headless browsers don't have it, so the rejection is swallowed by .catch(() => {}). The user gets no feedback and the link is not copied. Reference: /app/frontend/app/poll/[id].tsx:59

issues: The success toast ('It's Domino's Pizza!') shows at the top on top of the header back button and title. White text on light green has low contrast.
Every vote cast from the app is labeled 'Me' (hardcoded name). If two app users vote, both show as 'Me' in the voter names line.
The delete (trash) button deletes the poll right away with no confirmation.
Group votes list shows only the 5 latest polls (slice(0,5)) and has no 'see all'.

action_items: Add a web fallback to the poll share button: if Platform.OS === 'web' and navigator.share is missing, or Share.share rejects, copy pollLink(p.id) to the clipboard (expo-clipboard or navigator.clipboard) and show a toast 'Link copied'.
Optional: return 404 from DELETE /api/polls/{id} when the poll doesn't exist, and reject closing a poll with 0 votes or one that is already closed (400).
Optional: let the app user set a voter name instead of the hardcoded 'Me', ask for confirmation before deleting a poll, and move the toast so it doesn't cover the header.
critical_code_review_comments: poll/[id].tsx keeps polling every 4s (refetchInterval) even after the poll is closed. Stop when p.closed.
StartVoteButton creates a new poll on every tap. Repeated taps on the same results make duplicate polls (no dedupe).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; share on web gives no result)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ polls during the tests and deleted them all, along with the UI-created pizza and Rome polls. The 'Test vote' poll made by the main agent was left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Polls API regression tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_polls_api.py. Voter identity is stored in localStorage ('voter_id' in the app, 'ih_voter' on the HTML page), so each browser context is a separate voter. The HTML vote page is at {EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/polls/{id}/page. Take poll-winner screenshots after about 2s because of the ZoomIn animation.
